target.title: fix(tlon): bound external image upload reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Tlon image upload from external URLs could cause out-of-memory failures when a message-linked image URL streams an oversized body.

The upload path already validated http/https URLs and used SSRF-protected fetch, but the success path still called unbounded `response.blob()`, so a hostile or misbehaving image host could buffer arbitrarily large data before upload.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace direct `fetchWithSsrFGuard` + `response.blob()` with the same bounded media reader already used by `extensions/tlon/src/monitor/media.ts`: `readRemoteMediaBuffer` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/media-runtime` with `MAX_IMAGE_BYTES` (6 MiB) and a 30s idle timeout. This keeps upload and inbound media download on one shared cap instead of adding plugin-local limits.

## User Impact

When Tlon tries to upload an image from a message URL, oversized remote bodies now fail safely and the channel falls back to the original URL (existing behavior on error). Normal-sized images upload unchanged.

## Evidence

Focused tests:

```text
pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
```

Result: 8/8 passed, including a new regression for payloads exceeding `MAX_IMAGE_BYTES`.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Unbounded `response.blob()` on Tlon external image upload could OOM when a hostile image URL streams a large body.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS, Node 22, `node:http` loopback server on `127.0.0.1`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node scripts/proof-tlon-upload-bound.mjs`
  2. `pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
  ok: rejected oversized image body
  ok: bounded error mentions maxBytes
  ok: unbounded blob() read full ~12 MiB body (12582912 bytes)
  ok: small image parsed
  ok: content type preserved

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS PASSED
```

```text
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** `readRemoteMediaBuffer` rejects ~12 MiB image streams at the 6 MiB cap with a `maxBytes` error; small images still parse; negative control shows unbounded `response.blob()` would read the full body.
- **What was not tested:** Live Urbit/Tlon storage upload against production memex endpoints; proof used loopback fetch only.

## Tests and validation

- `pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose`
- `node scripts/proof-tlon-upload-bound.mjs` (local proof script, not committed)
- Regression test added: `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts` oversized cap case

## Risk checklist

- Did user-visible behavior change? Yes — oversized remote images no longer attempt unbounded buffering; they fall back to the original URL.
- Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? No
- Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? Yes — remote image reads are now bounded on the success path.
- Highest-risk area: Tlon channel image upload from external URLs in messages.
- Mitigation: Reuses existing `MAX_IMAGE_BYTES` shared with Tlon inbound media download; errors already fall back to original URL.

## Current review state

- Next action: awaiting maintainer review
- Bot comments addressed: none yet

## AI-assisted disclosure

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor agent)
- [x] Human-run Real behavior proof from local setup
- [ ] `codex review --base upstream/main` (not run yet)
